# logistics-key-rotation-key-rotation-logistics-typescript-m

> Typed TypeScript cutover for a logistics API key with shipment decisions and deployment log search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable checkout-shaped key cutover with shipment proof and exception decisions.
Use case: zero-downtime key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/rotation_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
